<thought>Based on the provided fragments, a reasonable way to connect them into a single SMILES string is to attach a three‑carbon chain to the benzene ring and terminate the chain with an –O–O–Cl group. This yields the SMILES “c1ccccc1CCCOOCl”.</thought>
<final_answer>c1ccccc1CCCOOCl</final_answer>
